entities.summary: Giancarlo Marinelli was an Italian basketball player who competed in the 1936 Summer Olympics and the 1948 Summer Olympics. He was born in Bologna. Marinelli was part of the Italian basketball team, which finished seventh in the Olympic tournament. He played four matches.
